shape_hint: A plain straight cylindrical rod with the metric thread cut over its entire length (fully threaded, no head, no shank); both ends are chamfered or cone-ended (DIN 976-1 Form B) so a nut can start on either end.

role_map.As: nominal tensile stress area per ISO 898-1 (mm2)

notes: DIN 976-1 itself tabulates little beyond d, P, length range/tolerance and weight; no public source tables for chamfer length were found. Length L is customer-specified (any length, max normally 1000 mm; 3000 mm for rod). ASME B18.31.1M continuous studs use Umax = 2P thread runout, preferred lengths 12-20 step 4, 25-50 step 5, 60-160 step 10, >=180 step 20 (2 sources only, not in table). Pitch: fine pitches exist but only coarse kept. Draw: pitch diameter d2 = d - 0.6495P, minor d3 = d - 1.2269P (formulas, not tabulated).

As - Nordic Fastening Group: nfgab.com ('Nominal stress area mm2'; Swedish decimal commas, grouped cells)
As - TR Fastenings: trfastenings.com ('Nominal stress area (mm2)'; own typos M4 8.76, class '9.6')
P also from: engineeringtoolbox.com, nfgab.com, yaxiio.com (same pages as above)

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 9 URLs live (HTTP 200) and parsed the tables (NFG grouped cells split, comma decimals converted). Matrix 16 rows (M5..M39) x 2 columns (P, As). As: ETB, SLS, NFG, TR agree on all 16 rows; Yaxiio agrees on its 14 rows (M6-M36) -> 4 clusters on M5 and M39, 5 on M6-M36; 0 disagreements. P: ETB, NFG and Fuller cover all 16 rows; Yaxiio M6-M36; Andrews M12-M39 (10 sizes); BigBoltNut M16-M39; TorqBolt ASME B18.31.1M M5-M30,M36 -> min 4 clusters (M5: ETB, NFG, Fuller, TorqBolt), M39 has 5; 0 disagreements. As header text read in each source: ETB 'Nominal Stress Area As,nom (mm2)' (page cites ISO 898-1), SLS 'Nominal stress area, mm2' (cites ISO 898 Part 1), Yaxiio 'As (mm2)' with text 'As = stress area from ISO 898-1', NFG 'Nominal stress area mm2', TR 'Nominal stress area (mm2)' (NFG/TR show the ISO 898-1 property classes but no ISO number). Physical: As = pi/4 (d - 0.9382 P)^2 reproduces all 16 As within 0.38 %; P non-decreasing 0.8..4; As strictly increasing 14.2..976.
problems: Only P and As: As is an ISO 898-1 mechanical-property quantity (As,nom), not a DIN 976-1 / stud dimension; none of the 5 As sources is a DIN 976-1 page. Publish the standard as 'ISO 898-1 (As) + coarse pitch' rather than attributing As to DIN 976-1.

Table carries no stud geometry (no length range/tolerance, chamfer, weight): length tolerance (Andrews+TorqBolt only) and weights were rightly dropped. Value to the catalog is low but every cell passes.
As is printed rounded (58, 115, 157, 192, 245 ... as integers from M10/M14 up); ISO unrounded values from uis.no are not equal numerically but agree to <0.2 % (not counted).
Stress area/pitch cluster note: the 5 As pages all reproduce the same ISO 898-1 table, but they differ in layout and typos (TR: 8.76 at M4, '9.6'), so they were counted as independent.
